bayts.text: (Praise) to a Forgiving Lord, Who erased sin from me and repelled Iblīs from me, in the sea of Mayumba,
and bestowed on me the Qurʾān and the Sunna, which hold back enemies, shame, the Fire and insult.
He led my aims to me by subjecting those who had rebelled; He bestowed on me the finest good and defended my station.
He guarded my secrets from all creation, and repelled from me, in my exile, want and narrow straits.
He held harm back from me with a guarding that surrounds me, and by it shielded me, in my exile, from the evil of what creeps.
(To Him) my repentance, my contentment, my gratitude and my praise: how generous a Lord He is! Through Him my heart has grown.
I shall please Him, a servant pleased with Him and grateful, by being His servant and the servant of him whom He loved.
I call on Him intimately with the Qurʾān, thanking Him by it for His safekeeping, unceasingly, and through it I hope for love.
A mighty Book: no worshipper observes it and recites it without attaining opening and nearness.
A noble Book from a Noble One Who honours, for a noble servant who illumined East and West.
A glorious Book from a Glorious One Who glorifies, for a glorious servant who rose above non-Arabs and Arabs.
A mighty Book from a Mighty One Who gives might, for a mighty servant beneath whom stands whoever has attained nearness.
Blessed then is the servant who worships Allah, his Lord, with the measured recitation of a mighty Qurʾān that guards against distress!
A Book I held fast to, content with it alone, a stranger (in exile), and it made me forget misfortunes and gloom.
Through it my grief vanished when I seized it as guidance; through it I shall guide my soul and guide the companions.
Whoever does not hold fast to it all his time, Iblīs has already led him, he who never ceases to deceive.
In my Lord I take refuge for ever from his cunning and from all enemies: what an excellent Lord is the Lord of creatures!
My God, spare me Iblīs and imprison him for ever, and grant me unceasing remembrance, gratitude and love.
My God, hold the enemies back from me and save me from disbelief and ingratitude, and spare me despoiling.
My God, guard me from inclining to what is not approved, keep calamities from me and spare me deceit.
O Lord, I have repented of all that is past: so erase all my faults from me and spare me corruption.
O Lord, forgive me, erase my presumption from me, accept my repentance and ever spare me apostasy.
To Him I have repented, holding fast to the Qurʾān, with the Chosen One, the Select, he who never ceases to be the beloved,
my imām, whose servant You made me through poetry and prose: through him illumine the heart.
To him my service as long as I live: so be, through him, my Refuge from corruption, and tame for me, through him, what is hard.
Decree for him a blessing with peace, with his Family and his Companions, and through him accept my earnings from me.
And grant me, through him, in this world and the Other, my desires, and ever drive misfortune from my precinct through him.
And open for me through him a manifest opening that leads me to piety and God-fearing, and keep me from conceit.
To You is my complaint, Lord, of my ignorance and my exile: so lead me to my brothers through him, and spare me perdition.
And teach me the knowledge from Your presence (Qurʾān 18:65), (making me) excellent, obedient, God-fearing, prosperous, a guide to the people.
And gladden all the Muslims with my return to my brothers, and before it fulfil my need for me.
And lead to me for ever, by the rank of the Chosen One, my need, without toil on my part, and grant me through him the (divine) attraction.
And hasten my departure from all my faults, lead me to Ṭūbā (Touba) and turn drought away from it.
And turn Satan and evil away from it for ever, direct good things to me and make (its) soil secure.
And bless us in it and in all it contains; make me dwell in it and guide me (with my) companions, one after another.
My God, to Dār as-Salām (Darou Salam), in which I call on You intimately, lead me soon, and spare me war.
And keep the aggressors and the wicked away from my side, for ever, and grant me victory, affection and nearness.
And increase me in sciences, (making me) endowed with guidance and uprightness, and through me nurture, O my Lord, the far and the near.
And grant me, through You, independence from creatures, (making me) servant of him whose generosity has shamed the pouring downpour:
my beloved, my companion in my exile and in my grave, my intercessor tomorrow, on the day the enemies meet perdition.
Upon him be the blessing of Allah, then His peace, with the Family and the Companions who gained abundance with him.
My God, erase all my faults and spare me harm through him, and spare me enemies, the Fire and insult.
And lead me to my family, safe and laden with gain, through him, and ever guard me from Iblīs, shame and sin.
To You be gratitude and contentment from me, and my witness is a ready Watcher (Qurʾān 50:18), on the island, at Mayumba.
